_provenance: Entries carry "verified":"probed live 2026-09-05" only when that exact token returned live jobs from its public API during a browser probe on 2026-09-05. 25 tokens were healed (see healed_from). 38 companies had no browser-reachable board on any of greenhouse/lever/ashby/workable after ~10 slug variants each and were moved to needs_route. BambooHR cannot be probed from a browser (CORS) — those rows are unverified by design and only the GitHub Action can confirm them. 2026-09-05 route pass: Starfish Space resolved to ashby:starfish-space-inc; Firefly Aerospace, Sierra Nevada Corporation and K2 Space moved to custom with confirmed careers URLs. The probe pages now read this file directly and no longer flatten hyphens in token variants. Route-finder pass resolved 5 more: First Resonance, Radiant Industries and Base Power on Ashby, Array Labs on Greenhouse (token "array"), Aetherflux on Recruitee (new bucket) — 301 additional live postings. Four of the five required hyphenated tokens, which the old probes could not generate. Astroscale resolved to smartrecruiters:AstroscaleUS — SmartRecruiters identifiers are PascalCase, a form the probes previously never generated. CesiumAstro resolved to lever:CesiumAstro (266 roles). Net: 12 of the original 38 unrouted companies now resolved — 9 on live public APIs, 3 as confirmed careers portals with no API. 27 remain genuinely unrouted. 2026-09-06 second route pass widened the probe from six to twenty-two public ATS APIs and added post-acquisition trading names: Capella Space resolved to greenhouse:ionq (acquired by IonQ), Zeno Power and HEO Robotics to Breezy HR, Orbit Fab to Rippling ATS — two more buckets (breezy, rippling) and 141 additional live postings. All four were confirmed by reading back real job titles and locations, not by token match alone. 23 remain unrouted. Third pass: ABL Space Systems resolved only after adding its post-rename identity Long Wall (lever:longwall) — no abl* form could ever have matched; Xona Space Systems to ashby:xona-space; Venturi Astrolab to Pinpoint (new bucket). Castelion's board was identified as Manatal (careers-page.com is Manatal's hosted product) with a CORS-open API at api.manatal.com/open/v3/career-page/<slug>/jobs/ returning 191 postings. Entity-lineage pass resolved three more: Voyager Space to greenhouse:voyagertechnologiesinc (legal-entity slug, 156 roles, and the home of the former Astrobotic as Voyager Lunar Systems), Starpath Robotics to ashby:starpath.space (dot-TLD identifier — the generator strips dots, a third token-shape bug alongside hyphens and case), Aalyria to rippling:aalyria-careers (-careers suffix). X-Bow Systems is Paylocity (identified, no public JSON) and Chandra Industries is flagged manual_sourcing_only as a probable entity misidentification. 15 remain unrouted.
_greenhouse_shape: Value shapes: "token": "Display Name", or "token": {"company","verified","open","healed_from"} for a probe-confirmed board, or {"company","unverified":true} for an unprobed guess. NOTE: Lever and SmartRecruiters tokens are CASE-SENSITIVE (CesiumAstro, AstroscaleUS). Never lowercase a token before probing it.

api_notes.manatal: api.manatal.com/open/v3/career-page/<slug>/jobs/ — paginated 10/page, follow "next"; title field is position_name; per-posting URL is careers-page.com/<slug>/job/<hash>
api_notes.breezy: <slug>.breezy.hr/json — array; title field is name; each row carries its own /p/<friendly_id> URL
api_notes.rippling: api.rippling.com/platform/api/ats/v1/board/<slug>/jobs — array; each row carries an ats.rippling.com apply URL
api_notes.pinpoint: <slug>.pinpointhq.com/postings.json — {data:[...]}; location is an object with name/city/province
api_notes.smartrecruiters: api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/<Identifier>/postings — {content:[...]}; identifiers are PascalCase and case-sensitive; list endpoint carries no description
api_notes.zohorecruit: <host>/jobs/Careers — HTML with an HTML-escaped JSON list of records (Posting_Title, City, Country, id)
api_notes.successfactors: <host>/search/?q=&startrow=N — HTML rows tr.data-row (a.jobTitle-link, .jobLocation, .jobDate); job page has .jobdescription
api_notes.radancy: <host>/en/search-jobs/results?CurrentPage=N&RecordsPerPage=50&SearchType=5... (X-Requested-With) — JSON {results: HTML list}; data-total-results gives the total
